transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Community Housing Support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I'm having trouble paying rent and wanted to see if there are programs that could help.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I can help with that. What is your name, and what city do you live in?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are you renting, and how much is your monthly rent?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I rent an apartment. It's $1,450 a month.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: About two months. I owe around $2,900.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you received an eviction notice from your landlord?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Not yet. They sent a notice saying I need to pay by October 15th or they may start the eviction process.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: What caused you to fall behind?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I lost my warehouse job in August. I'm on unemployment and doing some delivery work, about $1,700 a month total.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: How many people live in your household?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Three. Me and my two kids, eight and twelve.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. You may qualify for emergency rental assistance and eviction prevention. Is this number the best way to reach you, and may our team contact you about your case?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes to both. I just don't want us to lose the apartment.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Understood. Since your deadline is the 15th, I'm connecting you with a housing counselor now. Please have your lease and the landlord's notice ready.

report.summary: Renter with two children is 2 months ($2,900) behind on rent after a job loss. Landlord deadline is Oct 15 before possible eviction filing. Income is $1,700/month against $1,450 rent. Transferred to a housing counselor for emergency rental assistance.
next_steps: Contact landlord before Oct 15 about pending assistance
